sql:
SELECT
    country,
    CustomerKey,
    customer_name,
    total_spend,
    country_rank
FROM
(
    SELECT
        g.RegionCountryName AS country,
        c.CustomerKey,
        concat(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS customer_name,
        sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS total_spend,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY g.RegionCountryName
            ORDER BY sum(fos.SalesAmount) DESC, c.CustomerKey
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
    INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
        ON fos.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    INNER JOIN retail.DimGeography AS g
        ON c.GeographyKey = g.GeographyKey
    GROUP BY
        g.RegionCountryName,
        c.CustomerKey,
        c.FirstName,
        c.LastName
)
WHERE country_rank <= 5
ORDER BY country, country_rank, CustomerKey
